title: Debug the class
prompt: `Dog` compiles but `speak()` returns "Woof, I am null" — the field was never stored. Find and fix the one-line constructor bug.

tests.name: dog speaks
tests.code:
Solution.Dog d = new Solution.Dog("Rex");
CjTestBase.checkEq(d.speak(), "Woof, I am Rex", "named dog");
tests.hint: The constructor parameter is dropped on the floor; assign it to name.
